_comment: Phase 12.B.0 pilot: GCP Secret Manager Discovery JSON drives the spec-driven routing layer. cmd/gcp-codegen emits a Routes slice of (httpMethod, uriPattern, operationID) triples; downstream the gcp_secretmanager frontend can compile those patterns into its existing regex/ServeMux dispatch. Wire types come from google.golang.org/api/secretmanager/v1 directly per AGENTS.md decision #11.
